newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Thursday, as the yen's further slip against the dollar stimulated short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.6 yen to 3.0 yen per kg firmer, with benchmark October ending up 2.7 yen at 140.7 yen.
The market started the day firmer and extended early gains after the dollar rose to 127.45 yen in late Tokyo trade.
"The market lacked trading incentives except for the currency market," a commodity brokerage analyst said. He said the topside would be capped by near-term ample supplies.
